scope: Broaden open-source DXF peer comparison and distinguish explicit 3D entities from similarly named planar SOLID and proprietary ACIS carriers.

evidenceKinds: open-source project README and compatibility statement
notPerformed: IxMilia.Dxf or netDxf build or runtime
AutoCAD or other native CAD acceptance test

evidence.route: IxMilia.Dxf typed entity and writer capability claims
observed: The project README states DXF read/write coverage from R10 through R2014, except for MESH, MLEADER, SURFACE, TABLE, and VIEWPORT.
Its AutoCAD compatibility section names Dxf3DSolid, DxfRegion, and DxfBody among entity types that may not open when written.
The documentation is project-authored and was reviewed as mutable main; no exact release/runtime or payload behavior was tested.
limits: Typed class existence does not show that raw SAT/SAB bytes are retained or that R2013+ ACDSDATA keys resolve to the correct entity.
The README does not establish geometry construction, B-rep validity, current AutoCAD acceptance, or semantic behavior.
The broad version range is not a per-entity support result.
evidence.planAction: Admit only as an optional exact-release typed-entity/round-trip characterization at the composed peer checkpoint. Record parse recognition, source handle/type/owner, carrier observability/hash, output disposition, and native acceptance independently. Treat unavailable bytes as NOT_OBSERVED and do not use its writer as a positive native acceptance oracle.

observed: GitHub marks the netDxf repository archived on 2023-10-11.
The inspected Solid class stores four Vector2 vertices in OCS with separate elevation and thickness, matching classic planar DXF SOLID rather than ACIS 3DSOLID.
The source review did not establish support or lack of support for every other proprietary modeler entity.
limits: This is historical source evidence, not a current peer runtime result.
A Solid API name cannot be counted as a 3DSOLID/SAT/SAB/AcDs capability.
evidence.planAction: Keep classic SOLID/TRACE, explicit 3DFACE/polyface/MESH, and proprietary 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY ACIS carriers as separate coverage rows. Never infer B-rep support from an API class name.

observed: The documented 3DSOLID record identifies AcDbModelerGeometry and AcDb3dSolid subclass markers, modeler-format group 70, proprietary payload chunks in groups 1 and 3, and optional history soft-owner handle group 350.
The record reference does not make group 70 an embedded ACIS save version or geometry-validity indicator.
limits: The group-code table does not define all embedded ACIS/ASM semantics or the R2013+ AcDs ownership/index schema.
Documented carrier fields do not prove a peer reader interpreted or preserved them.
evidence.planAction: Keep modeler-format version, embedded ACIS version, carrier chunks/hash, history closure, typed geometry, and downstream acceptance as separate observations. No parser behavior is inferred from peer class names.

implementationReadiness.peerCheckpoint: Optional composed-stage comparison only; no per-slice peer runtime.
entityMatrix: explicit 3DFACE, polyface, polygon mesh, and subdivision MESH
proprietary ACIS 3DSOLID, REGION, and BODY carriers
implementationReadiness.evidenceSeparation: Entity-name recognition, raw carrier bytes, ownership/key association, typed geometry, B-rep semantics, and native acceptance remain distinct outcomes.
implementationReadiness.inputPolicy: Locally generated ephemeral controls only; no external drawing fixtures.
